title: 국제민사사법공조규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Reimbursement of Actual Expenses of Judicial Cooperation)
(1) When forwarding documents concerning the result of a request for judicial cooperation, the Minister of Foreign Affairs and Trade or the head of an overseas diplomatic mission shall attach a statement detailing expenses paid or advanced for service or examination of evidence. <Amended on June 28, 2002>
(2) On receiving the statement of expenses under paragraph (1), the requested court shall, without delay, send an order to release money held in court custody to the revenue and expenditure cash officer so that the equivalent amount may be transferred from the advance deposit under Article 9 of the Act to the National Treasury. <Amended on June 28, 2002>
(3) Where the expenses in paragraph (2) are denominated in a foreign currency, the amount to be transferred to the National Treasury shall be converted into Korean won at the foreign exchange trading reference rate prevailing on the date of transfer.
